displacement (i.e. Δx, Δy)174        self.delta = torch.stack(torch.meshgrid(dy, dx, indexing="ij"), dim=-1)  # shape: (2r+1, 2r+1, 2)175176    def corr_sample(self, targets, coords):177        """178
